headline: A 2018 law renames a Birmingham, Alabama Postal Service facility after Marine Lance Corporal Thomas E. Rivers, Jr.
what_it_does: This law officially names a U.S. Postal Service building at 1900 Corporate Drive in Birmingham, Alabama, as the "Lance Corporal Thomas E. Rivers, Jr. Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing at the site.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 24, 2018.
